text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's New Year's Day, and I'm on my way
to the
shrine for my first visit of the
year...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Are you heading to the shrine this
year, too?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I see. Actually, there's something I'm
hoping to
pray for myself, so I was just
on my way there too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Would you mind if I joined you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we end up making our way to
the shrine
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap! Clap!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Okay. Thank you for waiting.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I hope my prayer travels safely and
surely, on the
year's first easterly wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I prayed that your year would be
as warm
as the sunlit breeze, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
You've always been right there beside
me
throughout my time in the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes you're a radiant breeze. At
other
times, a powerful gale. But you're
always a
tailwind to me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to offer up a
prayer—for you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I hope you have a great year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following our chat, Yamanin Zephyr
suggests we
take a stroll around the
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there are a lot of stalls here.
They're
selling grilled carrots, takoyaki...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and they're giving out red bean
soup over
there...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And look how many charms are on sale.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The shrine truly comes to life when the
winds of
the new year are dancing
through it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well, where should we go first?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Great. There are a lot of stalls here, so
let's make
our way around like a
leisurely breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Something smells nice. A
mouth-watering aroma
wafting over on
the breeze...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Sorry about that. It's got my
stomach
rumbling.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Mind if I buy a grilled carrot? They're sweet and very delicious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, our second New
Year's
together draws to a close. I can't
wait to spend
another thrilling year by
Yamanin Zephyr's side.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how lovely. The mellow breeze is
carrying a
sweet aroma.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Shall we go and get some?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Blow...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Heh, it's still a bit too hot.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind's whooshing through the
flowers. Let's
let that breeze cool this
soup a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, our second New
Year's
together draws to a close. I can't
wait to spend
another thrilling year by
Yamanin Zephyr's side.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Actually, I was curious about
those too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Their colors are as vivid as the birds that
chirp
upon the mountainside.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh... That charm looks a little like a
Daruma
birdie, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And these white and gray ones look like
little
Salted Bean birds.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
They're adorable. And they ward off
illness and
injury, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. I'd like two of this one,
please.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes... For you. Heh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, our second New
Year's
together draws to a close. I can't
wait to spend
another thrilling year by
Yamanin Zephyr's side.
